topology: same-host native Claude, scripted loopback API, disposable homes, loopback-only network and PID namespaces

native_local_baseline.method: native Bash in the child, observer-only Mod, no Cowboy interception
native_local_baseline.interrupt_with_active_parent_turn: parent and background child Bash aborted; child notification status stopped; no late child effect
native_local_baseline.interrupt_while_parent_idle: background child still stopped with status stopped; no further model request
native_local_baseline.taskstop_on_agent: TaskStop returns task_type local_agent; child Bash aborted; a stopped notification then drives one parent turn
native_local_baseline.next_signal_while_awaiting_native_next: aborts for parent call on interrupt (remote-cancel) and child call on interrupt or TaskStop
native_local_baseline.tool_inventory: TaskOutput absent from init tools even when listed in --tools; SendMessage present
native_local_baseline.agent_launch_text: native result tells the model not to Read output_file (raw JSONL transcript); notification <result> carries the final answer

mod_contract_observations: register(on) must contain only on(...) registrations; a const declaration there silently disables the module on this build
two unfiltered turn.complete handlers in one module silently disable it; filtered duplicates (session.append door, prompt.attachment type) load

an idle notification is session.append door prompt with origin task-notification; one arriving during a turn is a queued_command attachment: session.append door delivery plus prompt.attachment type queued_command
while a hook's $.http.fetch is pending, the runtime processes no other native work: a text-only parent turn waited 25 s for a held child fetch, and native TaskStop could not run
with the child's call split into 1 s fetches, parent turns start within 1 s and next.signal aborts the held child hook on TaskStop; $.http remains usable from the abort listener
a resumed session can settle a previous process's agent notification as a zero-turn result (num_turns 0, duration_api_ms 0) before any client command
consequences_for_plugin_3_5_0: bridge idle hold reduced from 20 s to 1 s
per-call cancellation from next.signal plus owner cancellation after native TaskStop or aborted turn.complete
interrupt forwarded to native before target cancellation
notification projection on prompt and delivery doors and queued_command renders
readiness tolerates only a zero-turn zero-API task-notification result
